notes.title: Battle Interface
notes.content:
I started redrawing the UI interface. I think you will like the new version! ːsteamthumbsupː
You can see the 3 buttons to the left of the iron shield. There will be active abilities located there. The other three buttons, which are located to the right of the shield, will be responsible for passive abilities. All these abilities can be upgraded and get a perfect new hero! =D

Please don't forget to add the game to your wish list! It's easy for you, and nice for me!ːsteamhappyː

Add to wishlist - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1464250?utm_source=steamGroup
